goal: To design and build a modern, professional, and visually appealing web presence for Medicare In A Box.
deliverables: Newly redesigned web site for medicareinabox.org
The features listed below apply to the web site - medicareinabox.org

description: Integrate with existing Shopify e-commerce platform account for product catalog, shopping cart management, payment processing, fulfillment, and order tracking
Storage of scalable content and images in Contentful Content Management System
Hosting, Domain, and Template usage costs for Blog on WordPress platform
Meta tags - title, description, keywords, and Open Graph tags for social media sharing
Foundational files - sitemap.xml, sitemap.json, rss.xml, robots.txt, not-found.html, manifest.webmanifest, humans.txt, security.txt, well-known.txt, Loading page, Global Errors page, Style Guide page
Rich Schemas for AI - Blog Posting, Breadcrumbs, FAQs, LocalBusiness, Podcast (if used), Product, Recipe, Review, Services, Website
Additional files for AI - llms.txt, ai.txt
Hosting via Amazon Web Services (AWS).  Services include AWS Amplify, AWS CloudFront CDN, AWS Route 53 DNS including SSL Certificate, AWS CloudWatch Logging
Distribution of images in Cloudinary Content Delivery System
Links of new / existing social media accounts added to the web site
Initial base pricing for building the web site: medicareinabox.org and creating new social media accounts is $5000.
Typical pricing for a small brochure site is $3,000.
Pricing for medicareinabox.org is based upon a much larger site, with more complexity including e-commerce integration with Shopify.
Discounting is applied based on building for both medicareinabox.org and simplystatedwb.com.
